notes.title: Kill Your Friends... Together!
notes.notes: "What a Cluster Fight" is a fast paced, chaotic, pixel art brawler about having fun through killing your friends! Enjoy good music, and beautiful backgrounds while you yell at your buddy for melting you with a flamethrower! The store page is updated, and "What a Cluster Fight" is out now! Enjoy!

notes.title: "What a Cluster Fight" Out Now!
notes.notes: "What a Cluster Fight" now features 8 playable characters by up to 4 friends! There are also many unique weapons and over 50 levels! Please grab your friends and have a party!

notes.title: Introducing Stats!
notes.notes: Keep track of kills, deaths, wins, and also a few miscellaneous stats as well. This update also includes some bug fixes for UI, movement, and game play.

notes.title: The Panther is Live!
notes.notes: The Panther is a robotic Panther that has a spiked tail designed to act as a whip which can do damage on the way out and back in. The Panther also deals more damage on its melee due to its sharp claws.
